Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[shadow creature]] settled into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oblis]] and the [[Oblee]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the world, determined to build a '''machine''' to remove the creature from the planet. The machine was constructed by the Oblee [[scientist-philosopher]]s inside a great hall on top of a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on Oblis and it was designed to harness the abilities of the [[Darkstaff]], a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that had been brought to Oblis by a [[Unidentified wandering trader|wandering trader]]. To power the machine, the scientist-philosophers created three [[Shard (Oblee)|focusing crystals]], into to which the entire Oblee species would channel their hopes and fears. When the machine was completed, [[Unidentified Oblee scientist-philosopher|one of the scientist-philosophers]] inserted the Darkstaff and one of the focusing [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] into a tray at the side of the machine, then activated the device. A [[Color/Legends|blue-colored]] beam of energy shot out of the top of the machine and struck the shadow creature, hurling it away from Oblis. However, the Darkstaff used the power that it had absorbed from the machine to trigger a chain reaction that caused Oblis to [[Destruction of Oblis|explode]] seconds later.
